name: sovereign-ssi
description: Sovereign — Personal Data Wallet (SSI Platform). Full-stack integration covering Node.js Lectures 1-48: Middleware, SSR, MongoDB, Sessions, JWT, Socket.io.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: cd server && node utils/seedData.js && node server.js
